title: Sawi language (Dardic)
description: Indo-Aryan language of Afghanistan and Pakistan
extract: Sawi, Savi, or Sauji, is an endangered Indo-Aryan language spoken in northeastern Afghanistan and north-western Pakistan. It is classified as a member of the Shina language cluster within the Dardic subgroup.
